decisions.mvp_decision: The MVP item 'Martha Lake (Snohomish County)' = this water (Lynnwood; Martha Lake Park fishing piers). Bank-fishing relevance and metro location make it the intended MVP lake; confirm with the product owner.

evidence: Official 'Lake Martha (Snohomish County)' page: '10.5 miles northwest of Marysville', centre 48.169,-122.341 (Warm Beach area; 'WB' = Warm Beach)

Official page Geo Code L3218 != stocking geo_code L3219, and no stocking row uses L3218: an official-source inconsistency. The alias is pinned by name, place and species, not by code
decisions.mvp_decision: Separate water; not in the MVP set. It is resolved so its plants are never shown under the Lynnwood lake.
